motionInspection.method: Frames sampled at 4 fps into labelled contact sheets (references/videos/vid-0N-frames.png) plus per-frame luma-difference (ffmpeg signalstats YDIF at 480 px over all 122 frames). Not watched in real time by the agent; audio not inspected (none requested).
motionInspection.limitation: Perceived pace and smoothness need the owner to watch the clips; sampling can miss sub-250 ms events, but YDIF shows no full-frame flash.
